observations: Photo 0 shows two separate black console units side by side, not one – inconsistent with a single-item listing.
Photo 1 shows a single matte-black console with a bronze/gold PlayStation logo on top.
Photo 2 shows the top panel with raised button-shape icons (triangle, circle, X, square) at the corners, a design feature specific to the PS4 Pro model line.
No power cable, controller, or receipt is visible in any photo.
A brownish mark/stain is visible near the logo area in photo 1.
No photo shows the console powered on, a rear port close-up, or a serial/model sticker.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4
claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement, not something a photo can confirm or deny.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal photos or screws showing tamper seals.
No power-on video or thermal test shown.
No rear port close-up or plugged-in test shown.
No controller appears in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (HDD, disc drive, overheating history)
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen, plus a few minutes of a game running
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.proof: A photo of the actual controller(s) next to the console with a timestamp or handwritten note

risks.risk: Origin/warranty claim (UK receipt) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the dated receipt matching the console's serial number

risks.risk: Unexplained stain near the logo could indicate liquid exposure or heat damage
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the stained area and the underside vents
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically damaged / risk of internal damage

risks.risk: Two units shown in photo 0 raises doubt about which exact unit is for sale
risks.proof: A single clear photo of only the unit being sold, with serial number visible
risks.if_unproven: priced with uncertainty discount for possible mismatch

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game, showing the PS4 home screen
Photo of the controller(s) actually included
Photo of the UK receipt with matching serial number
Close-up of the stained area near the top logo
Photo of the serial number sticker on the underside
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Pro from its distinctive top-panel button icons, but none of the seller's functional or accessory claims are supported by the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, accessory-incomplete unit with a cosmetic blemish.
